verdict.rationale: Muse lets users customize their single personal agent: you can name it, give it an avatar and style, and "shape how it talks." Side chats keep separate context for certain topics, and files placed in the VM give it working material. That is only a thin version of building distinct custom assistants. Missing for 10: creating multiple separate custom assistants, per-assistant instructions and knowledge bases, any way to share or publish assistants with others, and independent hands-on corroboration.
